description: This is a test source file for the ContactsHandler class in an Android application. It contains unit tests that validate contact handling functionalities such as searching and adding contacts, permission checks, and response validation.

classes.name: ContactsHandlerTest
classes.description: A test class derived from NodeHandlerRobolectricTest, containing multiple test cases for verifying contact handling functionalities.

classes.name: FakeContactsDataSource
classes.description: A mock implementation of ContactsDataSource used for testing, simulating contact data source with configurable permissions and results.

methods.name: handleContactsSearch_requiresReadPermission
methods.description: Tests that the contact search operation requires read permission and behaves correctly when permission is denied.

methods.name: handleContactsAdd_rejectsEmptyContact
methods.description: Verifies that adding an empty contact is rejected and returns the appropriate error.

methods.name: handleContactsSearch_returnsContacts
methods.description: Tests that searching contacts returns the expected contact data.

methods.name: handleContactsAdd_returnsAddedContact
methods.description: Checks that adding a contact returns the contact with expected fields and increments call count.
